insert into litemall_store (name, intro, phone, address, detailed_address, logo, latitude, longitude, business_hours, is_show, add_time, update_time, deleted) values
(#{name}, coalesce(#{intro}, ''), coalesce(#{phone}, ''), coalesce(#{address}, ''), coalesce(#{detailedAddress}, ''), coalesce(#{logo}, ''), #{latitude}, #{longitude}, coalesce(#{businessHours}, ''), coalesce(#{isShow}, 1), now(), now(), 0)
mapper.update: update litemall_store set name = #{name}, intro = coalesce(#{intro}, ''), phone = coalesce(#{phone}, ''), address = coalesce(#{address}, ''), detailed_address = coalesce(#{detailedAddress}, ''), logo = coalesce(#{logo}, ''), latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, business_hours = coalesce(#{businessHours}, ''), is_show = coalesce(#{isShow}, 1), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
